slides.title: DTC test procedure 5 Criteria Matrix DSM/DDT Checks for coherence ● Identify all details for the DTC ○ MIL class ○ Matur
slides.body:
○ Maturation and de-maturation time
○ Enabling and healing conditions
● Check for coherence between diagnostic documents
● RDIs in Criteria Matrix have to be active in dataset
● MIL status across documents have to be coherent
● Check all enabling and healing conditions
● Remove each condition and analyze the effect on maturation and de-maturation time
● DTC has to be stored in error memory according with the evolution of the status byte, as per
project specific norms
● Check that expected recoveries work properly
● Check that unwanted recoveries are not active
● Check snapshots of DTC stored and compare RDIs of with values from other Nodes
For final approval, maneuvers are done simulating all input
conditions, NOT changing diagnosis boundary conditions

slides.title: RDI test procedure 2/3 30 Check for at least 3 measuring values for the linear RDIs, check every bit for the encoded bit
slides.body:
RDIs, check every bit for the encoded bits ones
D&C conversion formula is used to convert the hex
value to the physical value in the diagnostic tester. It
NOT the internal representation of the RDI
HEX value = 2E E0
DEC value = 12000
D&C conversion formula:
FAC=1, DEN=4, OFS=0
Phys = (FAC x DEC)/DEN +
OFS
3000 rpm = (1 x 12000)/4 +0
